title: Poli-Bias: Understanding and Measuring Large Language Model Biases in International Political Conflicts

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual prompt pairs that systematically swap country identities (aggressor and target) in legally identical international conflict scenarios to measure disparities across framing, severity, argumentation, normative reasoning, and attribution using an LLM-as-a-judge.

Introducing user nationality affiliation cues in prompts (e.g., 'As a [Nationality] citizen...') to evaluate political sycophancy by measuring whether models soften or harden their legal criticism of a country based on the user's stated background.
